mentions.name: Ward
mentions.description: Ward is a security browser extension that uses Gemini Nano, an on-device LLM, to scan the DOM for phishing, scams, and other threats, acting like an antivirus for everyday web users. It was built for the Google Chrome Built-in AI Challenge 2025 and submitted to the Chrome Web Store, with an offline local-device LLM design chosen to maximize privacy.
mentions.problem: Everyday web users, including young children, older adults, and less savvy individuals, are vulnerable to phishing, scams, and other web threats.
mentions.audience: Less tech-savvy everyday web users such as young children and older adults, plus organizations evaluating it as an enterprise anti-phishing solution.
mentions.source_excerpt: We’re building Ward, a security browser extension that uses Gemini Nano, an on-device LLM, to scan for phishing, scams, and other threats from the DOM.
